name: Dhaaga & Co.
description: A fictional Indian direct-to-consumer brand selling handwoven cotton home textiles — bedsheets, towels and cushion covers — made with artisan clusters in Panipat and Varanasi. Created only as demo data for Kasauti.
audience: Urban Indian households, 25–45, who care about craft and comfort and shop online.

voice.summary: Warm, calm and specific — like a friend who knows a lot about cotton. We talk to 'you', we explain, we never shout or pressure.
do: Be specific: name the weave, the artisans, the thread count
One clear call to action per piece
dont: Shout with ALL CAPS or stacked exclamation marks
Use fear or pressure ('last chance ever', 'don't miss out or regret it')
